I attached a working draft that maps the rows (trueup_working_draft.xlsx). My proposed next steps:

- If they prefer a one-off true-up, Finance will need a short SOW addendum or PO.

If agreeable I'll draft a short proposal to send to Maya with both options and our recommendation to split the difference (accelerate 75% of remaining amortization + conditional co-fund release on receipts).

Quick legal/contract note — per the Marketplace Listing Agreement (section 5.2), credits tied to listing performance are subject to an "eligibility verification" and may be amortized if the merchant's onboarding exceeds 30 days. That said, we do have precedent for one-time true-ups when partners provide full documentation and there is a material business continuity reason (we've done this twice in 2025).

If we go the true-up + addendum route I can run a redline to section 5.2 to explicitly allow a single amortization acceleration for Q3–Q4 reconciliation. That would also give Finance the paper they need for the ledger reclassification.

I attached a quick redline (contract-section-5.2-redline.docx).

- Aditya

Hi Maya / Emma — thanks for the patience while we reviewed. Attached is our reconciled proposal (CR-Proposal-Nov2026.pdf) outlining two options:

Option A — One-time true-up: Redwood applies an accelerated credit of $40,500 to close the Aug–Oct gap (we absorb $12.5k of amortization acceleration). CloudRetail provides missing receipts for Oct within 10 business days; Finance issues a single credit memo.

Option B — Amortized adjustment: Redwood accelerates 75% of remaining amortization over two months and releases 60% of the pending co-fund; CloudRetail submits receipts and Finance nets the remainder in the December invoice.

We recommend Option A to simplify reconciliation for both teams; this requires a short addendum to section 5.2 (Aditya has a redline ready). If acceptable, I'll circulate the addendum and a DocuSign link for signature.
